CGAP-N09455-812.product_description[marketplace_id=ATVPD: NOTICE Mower Blade Inspection Log sign for golf courses. Log Blade Check Before Each Mow. This CGAP Safety NOTICE sign reads: MOWER BLADE INSPECTION LOG / LOG BLADE CHECK EACH SHIFT / REPORT BENT OR WORN BLADES. Documents that blades were looked at so bent or worn ones are replaced before they cause deck damage. Mount beside the deck stand or blade bench in the equipment shop. Written for golf courses, parks departments, landscape contractors and campuses. Printed on 8x12 inch .065 aluminum with a rust-resistant, UV-resistant finish and four pre-drilled corner holes, made in the USA by CGAP Safety and backed by a five-year warranty against fading, peeling and rust. Related standards and practice to review for your site: Mower maker maintenance guidance. A sign supports your site procedures; it does not replace training or supervision.
